reason: V4.39, V4.40 and Phase 1 Gate A use the same V4.32 neutral whole-cat surface and are visually almost identical in fixed views.
Phase 1 Gate B changes only a bounded torso field; it does not rebuild the head, neck, limbs, paws or tail root.
V4.40, Gate A and Gate B retain a nearly uniform white material and do not satisfy the required environment-NPC body appearance.
Walk and turn evidence remains mechanically similar across V4.40, Gate A and Gate B.

Runtime deformation diagnostics reach approximately 2.08x edge stretch and approximately 0.48x compression in tested action extremes, which is incompatible with treating the current skin as a reliable production body.

Historical V4.15 evidence documents a stronger anatomical authoring architecture, but that candidate was not visually accepted, its browser run was incomplete and its full source payload is not present in the current GitHub branch. It is a structural reference, not a reusable final body.
